request.deadline: 9-month delivery period from July 2026 to March 2027
deliverables: Audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access
Hardening, security audits, and formal verification
Stewardship structure and hardened economic model required for launch
request.what: Phase 1 of 2 for Bifrost, a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge, covering work from testnet to launch readiness including hardening, security audits, formal verification, ecosystem and partner readiness, stewardship, and economic foundations.

claims.claim: Bifrost is designed as a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge secured by Cardano's SPO ecosystem that brings BTC onto Cardano as a native Cardano asset for DeFi use cases.
The proposal requests ₳12,332,031, approximately $1,973,125 at 0.16 USD/ADA and including a 10% refundable contingency, for a 9-month Phase 1 delivery period.
By the end of Phase 1, Bifrost will be an audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access.
Public rollout and 24 months of operations are intentionally deferred to a Phase 2 proposal in Q1 2027 after the bridge has been proven on-chain.
Bifrost custody of locked BTC is claimed to be distributed across 400+ Cardano SPOs, weighted by delegation, rather than held by a company, foundation, or fixed signing committee.
The proposal states that Bifrost is live on testnet under Catalyst Fund 14 and is shipping against an active ₳739,000 Catalyst grant with approved early milestones.
Bifrost's smart contracts, off-chain tooling, and SDK are stated to be released under Apache 2.0 so anyone can audit, fork, run, or build on the bridge without permission.
The proposal claims Bifrost can contribute by Q2 2029 to 1,200 BTC in Cardano DeFi TVL, about 600,000 annual transactions, and 3,000 fBTC-holding wallets.
The proposal states that bridge fee surplus will be returned to the Cardano Treasury in fBTC while SPO rewards are paid in fBTC.
The proposal argues that Cardano lacks secure BTC rails today and that Bifrost would position Cardano to compete for Bitcoin DeFi liquidity.

summary: The document presents a large treasury request for launch-readiness work on Bifrost, a proposed SPO-secured Bitcoin-Cardano bridge, with stated technical, audit, stewardship, and ecosystem readiness deliverables, but many high-materiality security, adoption, and economic claims are asserted rather than evidenced within the supplied text.
